1.web: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,
1.kjv: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
1.bsb: Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus, called to be an apostle, and set apart for the gospel of God—

1.web: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,
1.kjv: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
1.bsb: the gospel He promised beforehand through His prophets in the Holy Scriptures,

1.web: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,
1.kjv: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
1.bsb: regarding His Son, who was a descendant of David according to the flesh,

1.web: who was declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
1.kjv: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
1.bsb: and who through the Spirit of holiness was declared with power to be the Son of God by His resurrection from the dead: Jesus Christ our Lord.

1.web: through whom we received grace and apostleship, for obedience of faith among all the nations, for his name’s sake;
1.kjv: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
1.bsb: Through Him and on behalf of His name, we received grace and apostleship to call all those among the Gentiles to the obedience that comes from faith.

1.web: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;
1.kjv: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
1.bsb: And you also are among those who are called to belong to Jesus Christ.

1.web: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.bsb: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.web: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
1.kjv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
1.bsb: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is being proclaimed all over the world.

1.web: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,
1.kjv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
1.bsb: God, whom I serve with my spirit in preaching the gospel of His Son, is my witness how constantly I remember you

1.web: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
1.kjv: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
1.bsb: in my prayers at all times, asking that now at last by God’s will I may succeed in coming to you.

1.web: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
1.kjv: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
1.bsb: For I long to see you so that I may impart to you some spiritual gift to strengthen you,

1.web: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
1.kjv: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
1.bsb: that is, that you and I may be mutually encouraged by each other’s faith.

1.web: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you, and was hindered so far, that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.
1.kjv: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
1.bsb: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, how often I planned to come to you (but have been prevented from visiting until now), in order that I might have a harvest among you, just as I have had among the other Gentiles.

1.web: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
1.kjv: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
1.bsb: I am obligated both to Greeks and non-Greeks, both to the wise and the foolish.

1.web: So, as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.
1.kjv: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
1.bsb: That is why I am so eager to preach the gospel also to you who are in Rome.

1.web: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes; for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.
1.kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
1.bsb: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek.

1.web: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”
1.kjv: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
1.bsb: For the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start to finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”

1.web: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
1.kjv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
1.bsb: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of men who suppress the truth by their wickedness.

1.web: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.
1.kjv: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
1.bsb: For what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them.

1.web: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity; that they may be without excuse.
1.kjv: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
1.bsb: For since the creation of the world God’s invisible qualities, His eternal power and divine nature, have been clearly seen, being understood from His workmanship, so that men are without excuse.

1.web: Because, knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, neither gave thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.
1.kjv: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
1.bsb: For although they knew God, they neither glorified Him as God nor gave thanks to Him, but they became futile in their thinking and darkened in their foolish hearts.

1.web: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
1.kjv: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
1.bsb: Although they claimed to be wise, they became fools,

1.web: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, and four-footed animals, and creeping things.
1.kjv: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
1.bsb: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images of mortal man and birds and animals and reptiles.

1.web: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;
1.kjv: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
1.bsb: Therefore God gave them over in the desires of their hearts to impurity for the dishonoring of their bodies with one another.

1.web: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
1.kjv: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
1.bsb: They exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is forever worthy of praise! Amen.

1.web: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.
1.kjv: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
1.bsb: For this reason God gave them over to dishonorable passions. Even their women exchanged natural relations for unnatural ones.

1.web: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.
1.kjv: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
1.bsb: Likewise, the men abandoned natural relations with women and burned with lust for one another. Men committed indecent acts with other men, and received in themselves the due penalty for their error.

1.web: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;
1.kjv: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
1.bsb: Furthermore, since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them up to a depraved mind, to do what ought not to be done.

1.web: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,
1.kjv: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
1.bsb: They have become filled with every kind of wickedness, evil, greed, and depravity. They are full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, and malice. They are gossips,

1.web: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
1.kjv: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
1.bsb: slanderers, God-haters, insolent, arrogant, and boastful. They invent new forms of evil; they disobey their parents.

1.web: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;
1.kjv: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
1.bsb: They are senseless, faithless, heartless, merciless.

1.web: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.
1.kjv: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
1.bsb: Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things are worthy of death, they not only continue to do these things, but also approve of those who practice them.

2.web: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.
2.kjv: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
2.bsb: You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on another. For on whatever grounds you judge the other, you are condemning yourself, because you who pass judgment do the same things.

2.web: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
2.kjv: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
2.bsb: And we know that God’s judgment against those who do such things is based on truth.

2.web: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?
2.kjv: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
2.bsb: So when you, O man, pass judgment on others, yet do the same things, do you think you will escape God’s judgment?

2.web: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
2.kjv: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
2.bsb: Or do you disregard the riches of His kindness, tolerance, and patience, not realizing that God’s kindness leads you to repentance?

2.web: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God;
2.kjv: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
2.bsb: But because of your hard and unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of wrath, when God’s righteous judgment will be revealed.

2.web: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
2.kjv: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
2.bsb: God “will repay each one according to his deeds.”

2.web: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
2.kjv: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
2.bsb: To those who by perseverance in doing good seek glory, honor, and immortality, He will give eternal life.

2.web: but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath and indignation,
2.kjv: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
2.bsb: But for those who are self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow wickedness, there will be wrath and anger.

2.web: oppression and anguish, on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
2.kjv: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
2.bsb: There will be trouble and distress for every human being who does evil, first for the Jew, then for the Greek;

2.web: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
2.kjv: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
2.bsb: but glory, honor, and peace for everyone who does good, first for the Jew, then for the Greek.

2.web: For there is no partiality with God.
2.kjv: For there is no respect of persons with God.
2.bsb: For God does not show favoritism.

2.web: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
2.kjv: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
2.bsb: All who sin apart from the law will also perish apart from the law, and all who sin under the law will be judged by the law.

2.web: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
2.kjv: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
2.bsb: For it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but it is the doers of the law who will be declared righteous.

2.web: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
2.kjv: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
2.bsb: Indeed, when Gentiles, who do not have the law, do by nature what the law requires, they are a law to themselves, even though they do not have the law.

2.web: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)
2.kjv: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
2.bsb: So they show that the work of the law is written on their hearts, their consciences also bearing witness, and their thoughts either accusing or defending them

2.web: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
2.kjv: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
2.bsb: on the day when God will judge men’s secrets through Christ Jesus, as proclaimed by my gospel.

2.web: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, and rest on the law, and glory in God,
2.kjv: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
2.bsb: Now you, if you call yourself a Jew; if you rely on the law and boast in God;

2.web: and know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
2.kjv: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
2.bsb: if you know His will and approve of what is superior because you are instructed by the law;

2.web: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
2.kjv: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
2.bsb: if you are convinced that you are a guide for the blind, a light for those in darkness,

2.web: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
2.kjv: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
2.bsb: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of infants, because you have in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth—

2.web: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
2.kjv: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
2.bsb: you, then, who teach others, do you not teach yourself? You who preach against stealing, do you steal?

2.web: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery. Do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
2.kjv: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
2.bsb: You who forbid adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

2.web: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?
2.kjv: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
2.bsb: You who boast in the law, do you dishonor God by breaking the law?

2.web: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.
2.kjv: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
2.bsb: As it is written: “God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you.”

2.web: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
2.kjv: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
2.bsb: Circumcision has value if you observe the law, but if you break the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

2.web: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?
2.kjv: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
2.bsb: If a man who is not circumcised keeps the requirements of the law, will not his uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision?

2.web: Won’t the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfills the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?
2.kjv: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
2.bsb: The one who is physically uncircumcised yet keeps the law will condemn you who, even though you have the written code and circumcision, are a lawbreaker.

2.web: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
2.kjv: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
2.bsb: A man is not a Jew because he is one outwardly, nor is circumcision only outward and physical.

2.web: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
2.kjv: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
2.bsb: No, a man is a Jew because he is one inwardly, and circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the written code. Such a man’s praise does not come from men, but from God.

3.web: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
3.kjv: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
3.bsb: What, then, is the advantage of being a Jew? Or what is the value of circumcision?

3.web: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.
3.kjv: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
3.bsb: Much in every way. First of all, they have been entrusted with the very words of God.

3.web: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
3.kjv: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
3.bsb: What if some did not have faith? Will their lack of faith nullify God’s faithfulness?

3.web: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “That you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”
3.kjv: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
3.bsb: Certainly not! Let God be true and every man a liar. As it is written: “So that You may be proved right when You speak and victorious when You judge.”

3.web: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.
3.kjv: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
3.bsb: But if our unrighteousness highlights the righteousness of God, what shall we say? That God is unjust to inflict His wrath on us? I am speaking in human terms.

3.web: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?
3.kjv: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
3.bsb: Certainly not! In that case, how could God judge the world?

3.web: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
3.kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
3.bsb: However, if my falsehood accentuates God’s truthfulness, to the increase of His glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?

3.web: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let us do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.
3.kjv: And not rather , (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
3.bsb: Why not say, as some slanderously claim that we say, “Let us do evil that good may result”? Their condemnation is deserved!

3.web: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin.
3.kjv: What then? are we better than they ? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
3.bsb: What then? Are we any better? Not at all. For we have already made the charge that Jews and Greeks alike are all under sin.

3.web: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
3.kjv: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
3.bsb: As it is written: “There is no one righteous, not even one.

3.web: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.
3.kjv: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
3.bsb: There is no one who understands, no one who seeks God.

3.web: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
3.kjv: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
3.bsb: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one.”

3.web: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips”;
3.kjv: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
3.bsb: “Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The venom of vipers is on their lips.”

3.web: “whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
3.kjv: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
3.bsb: “Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness.”

3.web: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.
3.kjv: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
3.bsb: “Their feet are swift to shed blood;

3.web: Destruction and misery are in their ways.
3.kjv: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
3.bsb: ruin and misery lie in their wake,

3.web: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”
3.kjv: And the way of peace have they not known:
3.bsb: and the way of peace they have not known.”

3.web: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
3.kjv: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
3.bsb: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

3.web: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.
3.kjv: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
3.bsb: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.

3.web: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight. For through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
3.kjv: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
3.bsb: Therefore no one will be justified in His sight by works of the law. For the law merely brings awareness of sin.

3.web: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;
3.kjv: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
3.bsb: But now, apart from the law, the righteousness of God has been revealed, as attested by the Law and the Prophets.

3.web: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,
3.kjv: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
3.bsb: And this righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no distinction,

3.web: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
3.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
3.bsb: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,

3.web: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;
3.kjv: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
3.bsb: and are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.

3.web: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice, through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;
3.kjv: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
3.bsb: God presented Him as the atoning sacrifice through faith in His blood, in order to demonstrate His righteousness, because in His forbearance He had passed over the sins committed beforehand.

3.web: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time; that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
3.kjv: To declare, I say , at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
3.bsb: He did this to demonstrate His righteousness at the present time, so as to be just and to justify the one who has faith in Jesus.

3.web: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
3.kjv: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
3.bsb: Where, then, is boasting? It is excluded. On what principle? On that of works? No, but on that of faith.

3.web: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
3.kjv: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
3.bsb: For we maintain that a man is justified by faith apart from works of the law.

3.web: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
3.kjv: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
3.bsb: Is God the God of Jews only? Is He not the God of Gentiles too? Yes, of Gentiles too,

3.web: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith, and the uncircumcised through faith.
3.kjv: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
3.bsb: since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.

3.web: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
3.kjv: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
3.bsb: Do we, then, nullify the law by this faith? Certainly not! Instead, we uphold the law.

4.web: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
4.kjv: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
4.bsb: What then shall we say that Abraham, our forefather, has discovered?

4.web: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
4.kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
4.bsb: If Abraham was indeed justified by works, he had something to boast about, but not before God.

4.web: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
4.kjv: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
4.bsb: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.”

4.web: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
4.kjv: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
4.bsb: Now the wages of the worker are not credited as a gift, but as an obligation.

4.web: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
4.kjv: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
4.bsb: However, to the one who does not work, but believes in Him who justifies the wicked, his faith is credited as righteousness.

4.web: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works,
4.kjv: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
4.bsb: And David speaks likewise of the blessedness of the man to whom God credits righteousness apart from works:

4.web: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
4.kjv: Saying , Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
4.bsb: “Blessed are they whose lawless acts are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

4.web: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
4.kjv: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
4.bsb: Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord will never count against him.”

4.web: Is this blessing then pronounced on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.
4.kjv: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only , or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
4.bsb: Is this blessing only on the circumcised, or also on the uncircumcised? We have been saying that Abraham’s faith was credited to him as righteousness.

4.web: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
4.kjv: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
4.bsb: In what context was it credited? Was it after his circumcision, or before? It was not after, but before.

4.web: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.
4.kjv: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
4.bsb: And he received the sign of circumcision as a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while he was still uncircumcised. So then, he is the father of all who believe but are not circumcised, in order that righteousness might be credited to them.

4.web: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.
4.kjv: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
4.bsb: And he is also the father of the circumcised who not only are circumcised, but who also walk in the footsteps of the faith that our father Abraham had before he was circumcised.

4.web: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he should be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
4.kjv: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
4.bsb: For the promise to Abraham and his offspring that he would be heir of the world was not given through the law, but through the righteousness that comes by faith.

4.web: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
4.kjv: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
4.bsb: For if those who live by the law are heirs, faith is useless and the promise is worthless,

4.web: For the law produces wrath, for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
4.kjv: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
4.bsb: because the law brings wrath. And where there is no law, there is no transgression.

4.web: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
4.kjv: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
4.bsb: Therefore, the promise comes by faith, so that it may rest on grace and may be guaranteed to all Abraham’s offspring—not only to those who are of the law, but also to those who are of the faith of Abraham. He is the father of us all.

4.web: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
4.kjv: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
4.bsb: As it is written: “I have made you a father of many nations.” He is our father in the presence of God, in whom he believed, the God who gives life to the dead and calls into being what does not yet exist.

4.web: Besides hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
4.kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
4.bsb: Against all hope, Abraham in hope believed and so became the father of many nations, just as he had been told, “So shall your offspring be.”

4.web: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
4.kjv: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara’s womb:
4.bsb: Without weakening in his faith, he acknowledged the decrepitness of his body (since he was about a hundred years old) and the lifelessness of Sarah’s womb.

4.web: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
4.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
4.bsb: Yet he did not waver through disbelief in the promise of God, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,

4.web: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
4.kjv: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
4.bsb: being fully persuaded that God was able to do what He had promised.

4.web: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
4.kjv: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
4.bsb: This is why “it was credited to him as righteousness.”

4.web: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
4.kjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
4.bsb: Now the words “it was credited to him” were written not only for Abraham,

4.web: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus, our Lord, from the dead,
4.kjv: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
4.bsb: but also for us, to whom righteousness will be credited—for us who believe in Him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.

4.web: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
4.kjv: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
4.bsb: He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification.

5.web: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
5.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
5.bsb: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,

5.web: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
5.kjv: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
5.bsb: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.

5.web: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
5.kjv: And not only so , but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
5.bsb: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;

5.web: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:
5.kjv: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
5.bsb: perseverance, character; and character, hope.

5.web: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
5.kjv: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
5.bsb: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.

5.web: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
5.kjv: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
5.bsb: For at just the right time, while we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.

5.web: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.
5.kjv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
5.bsb: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man, though for a good man someone might possibly dare to die.

5.web: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
5.kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
5.bsb: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

5.web: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
5.kjv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
5.bsb: Therefore, since we have now been justified by His blood, how much more shall we be saved from wrath through Him!

5.web: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
5.kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
5.bsb: For if, when we were enemies of God, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!

5.web: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
5.kjv: And not only so , but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
5.bsb: Not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.

5.web: Therefore as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; and so death passed to all men, because all sinned.
5.kjv: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
5.bsb: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, so also death was passed on to all men, because all sinned.

5.web: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
5.kjv: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
5.bsb: For sin was in the world before the law was given; but sin is not taken into account when there is no law.

5.web: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
5.kjv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
5.bsb: Nevertheless, death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the way that Adam transgressed. He is a pattern of the One to come.

5.web: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
5.kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
5.bsb: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many!

5.web: The gift is not as through one who sinned: for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.
5.kjv: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
5.bsb: Again, the gift is not like the result of the one man’s sin: The judgment that followed one sin brought condemnation, but the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification.

5.web: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
5.kjv: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
5.bsb: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive an abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!

5.web: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
5.kjv: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
5.bsb: So then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men.

5.web: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
5.kjv: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
5.bsb: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.

5.web: The law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;
5.kjv: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
5.bsb: The law came in so that the trespass would increase; but where sin increased, grace increased all the more,

5.web: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
5.kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
5.bsb: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

6.web: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
6.kjv: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
6.bsb: What then shall we say? Shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase?

6.web: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
6.kjv: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
6.bsb: Certainly not! How can we who died to sin live in it any longer?

6.web: Or don’t you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
6.kjv: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
6.bsb: Or aren’t you aware that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death?

6.web: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
6.kjv: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
6.bsb: We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death, in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may walk in newness of life.

6.web: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
6.kjv: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
6.bsb: For if we have been united with Him like this in His death, we will certainly also be united with Him in His resurrection.

6.web: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
6.kjv: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him , that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
6.bsb: We know that our old self was crucified with Him so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, that we should no longer be slaves to sin.

6.web: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
6.kjv: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
6.bsb: For anyone who has died has been freed from sin.

6.web: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him;
6.kjv: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
6.bsb: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with Him.

6.web: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no more has dominion over him!
6.kjv: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
6.bsb: For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead, He cannot die again; death no longer has dominion over Him.

6.web: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
6.kjv: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
6.bsb: The death He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life He lives, He lives to God.

6.web: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
6.kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
6.bsb: So you too must count yourselves dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

6.web: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
6.kjv: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
6.bsb: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its desires.

6.web: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God, as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
6.kjv: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
6.bsb: Do not present the parts of your body to sin as instruments of wickedness, but present yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life; and present the parts of your body to Him as instruments of righteousness.

6.web: For sin will not have dominion over you. For you are not under law, but under grace.
6.kjv: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
6.bsb: For sin shall not be your master, because you are not under law, but under grace.

6.web: What then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!
6.kjv: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
6.bsb: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law, but under grace? Certainly not!

6.web: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey; whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
6.kjv: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
6.bsb: Do you not know that when you offer yourselves as obedient slaves, you are slaves to the one you obey, whether you are slaves to sin leading to death, or to obedience leading to righteousness?

6.web: But thanks be to God, that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.
6.kjv: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
6.bsb: But thanks be to God that, though you once were slaves to sin, you wholeheartedly obeyed the form of teaching to which you were committed.

6.web: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
6.kjv: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
6.bsb: You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.

6.web: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
6.kjv: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
6.bsb: I am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. Just as you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to escalating wickedness, so now offer them in slavery to righteousness leading to holiness.

6.web: For when you were servants of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness.
6.kjv: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
6.bsb: For when you were slaves to sin, you were free of obligation to righteousness.

6.web: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
6.kjv: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
6.bsb: What fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? The outcome of those things is death.

6.web: But now, being made free from sin, and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification, and the result of eternal life.
6.kjv: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
6.bsb: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to God, the fruit you reap leads to holiness, and the outcome is eternal life.

6.web: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
6.kjv: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
6.bsb: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

7.web: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
7.kjv: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
7.bsb: Do you not know, brothers (for I am speaking to those who know the law), that the law has authority over a man only as long as he lives?

7.web: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
7.kjv: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
7.bsb: For instance, a married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.

7.web: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.
7.kjv: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
7.bsb: So then, if she is joined to another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress, even if she marries another man.

7.web: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.
7.kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
7.bsb: Therefore, my brothers, you also died to the law through the body of Christ, that you might belong to another, to Him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit to God.

7.web: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law, worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.
7.kjv: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
7.bsb: For when we lived according to the flesh, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in our bodies, bearing fruit for death.

7.web: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
7.kjv: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
7.bsb: But now, having died to what bound us, we have been released from the law, so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit, and not in the old way of the written code.

7.web: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin, except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting, unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”
7.kjv: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
7.bsb: What then shall we say? Is the law sin? Certainly not! Indeed, I would not have been mindful of sin if not for the law. For I would not have been aware of coveting if the law had not said, “Do not covet.”

7.web: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
7.kjv: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
7.bsb: But sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

7.web: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
7.kjv: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
7.bsb: Once I was alive apart from the law; but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life and I died.

7.web: The commandment, which was for life, this I found to be for death;
7.kjv: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
7.bsb: So I discovered that the very commandment that was meant to bring life actually brought death.

7.web: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
7.kjv: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me .
7.bsb: For sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through the commandment put me to death.

7.web: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
7.kjv: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
7.bsb: So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good.

7.web: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.
7.kjv: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
7.bsb: Did that which is good, then, become death to me? Certainly not! But in order that sin might be exposed as sin, it produced death in me through what was good, so that through the commandment sin might become utterly sinful.

7.web: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
7.kjv: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
7.bsb: We know that the law is spiritual; but I am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.

7.web: For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
7.kjv: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
7.bsb: I do not understand what I do. For what I want to do, I do not do. But what I hate, I do.

7.web: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
7.kjv: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
7.bsb: And if I do what I do not want to do, I admit that the law is good.

7.web: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
7.kjv: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
7.bsb: In that case, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.

7.web: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.
7.kjv: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
7.bsb: I know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my flesh; for I have the desire to do what is good, but I cannot carry it out.

7.web: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
7.kjv: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
7.bsb: For I do not do the good I want to do. Instead, I keep on doing the evil I do not want to do.

7.web: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
7.kjv: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
7.bsb: And if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.

7.web: I find then the law, that, to me, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
7.kjv: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
7.bsb: So this is the principle I have discovered: When I want to do good, evil is right there with me.

7.web: For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
7.kjv: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
7.bsb: For in my inner being I delight in God’s law.

7.web: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
7.kjv: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
7.bsb: But I see another law at work in my body, warring against the law of my mind and holding me captive to the law of sin that dwells within me.

7.web: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
7.kjv: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
7.bsb: What a wretched man I am! Who will rescue me from this body of death?

7.web: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, the sin’s law.
7.kjv: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
7.bsb: Thanks be to God, through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, with my mind I serve the law of God, but with my flesh I serve the law of sin.

8.web: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
8.kjv: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
8.bsb: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

8.web: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
8.kjv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
8.bsb: For in Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life set you free from the law of sin and death.

8.web: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh;
8.kjv: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
8.bsb: For what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the flesh, God did by sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful man, as an offering for sin. He thus condemned sin in the flesh,

8.web: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
8.kjv: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
8.bsb: so that the righteous standard of the law might be fulfilled in us, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.

8.web: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
8.kjv: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
8.bsb: Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh; but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.

8.web: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;
8.kjv: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
8.bsb: The mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,

8.web: because the mind of the flesh is hostile towards God; for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
8.kjv: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
8.bsb: because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God: It does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.

8.web: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
8.kjv: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
8.bsb: Those controlled by the flesh cannot please God.

8.web: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
8.kjv: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
8.bsb: You, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.

8.web: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
8.kjv: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
8.bsb: But if Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness.

8.web: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
8.kjv: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
8.bsb: And if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit, who lives in you.

8.web: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
8.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
8.bsb: Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation, but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.

8.web: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
8.kjv: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
8.bsb: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

8.web: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
8.kjv: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
8.bsb: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.

8.web: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
8.kjv: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
8.bsb: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

8.web: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
8.kjv: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
8.bsb: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.

8.web: and if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint heirs with Christ; if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
8.kjv: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him , that we may be also glorified together.
8.bsb: And if we are children, then we are heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ—if indeed we suffer with Him, so that we may also be glorified with Him.

8.web: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
8.kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
8.bsb: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.

8.web: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
8.kjv: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
8.bsb: The creation waits in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of God.

8.web: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
8.kjv: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
8.bsb: For the creation was subjected to futility, not by its own will, but because of the One who subjected it, in hope

8.web: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
8.kjv: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
8.bsb: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.

8.web: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
8.kjv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
8.bsb: We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time.

8.web: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
8.kjv: And not only they , but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit , the redemption of our body.
8.bsb: Not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.

8.web: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
8.kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
8.bsb: For in this hope we were saved; but hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what he can already see?

8.web: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
8.kjv: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it .
8.bsb: But if we hope for what we do not yet see, we wait for it patiently.

8.web: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
8.kjv: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
8.bsb: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.

8.web: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
8.kjv: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
8.bsb: And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.

8.web: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.
8.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
8.bsb: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.

8.web: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
8.kjv: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
8.bsb: For those God foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, so that He would be the firstborn among many brothers.

8.web: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
